title: Jesus, My Savior, Look On Me
firstLine: Jesus, my Savior, look on me, for I am weary and oppressed; I come to cast myself on Thee: Thou art my Rest.

tuneRef.title: My God My Father Tho' I Stray -

lines: Jesus, my Savior, look on me, for I am weary and oppressed; I come to cast myself on Thee: Thou art my Rest.
Look down on me, for I am weak; I feel the toilsome journey's length: Thine aid omnipotent I seek: Thou art my Strength.
I am bewildered on my way, dark and tempestuous is the night; O send Thou forth some cheering ray! Thou art my Light.
When Satan flings his fiery darts, I look to Thee, my terrors cease; Thy Cross a hiding place imparts: Thou art my Peace.
Thou wilt my every want supply, E'en to the end, what-e'er befall; Through life, in death, eternally, Thou art my All. A-MEN.
